## SocialDataX 知乎 Zhihu MCP

Search Zhihu answers, articles and videos; read trends, content details, comments, replies, creator profiles, articles and video transcripts. This is a first-party SocialDataX integration to the SocialDataX hosted API; SocialDataX is independent of the social platforms whose data it provides. Use it to examine public content and compare the relevant posts, comments or profiles. Configure your own `SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY` as `Authorization: Bearer <SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY>`; [API Key and setup](https://socialdatax.com/ai?from=toolhive), with business calls billed in SocialDataX credits. Public connection materials are MIT; the hosted service implementation is proprietary.
